summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BluBridge Admin Panel. Fixed critical backend bug where Authorization header was not being read (missing Header() import). All admin features working correctly after fix.

issues: Error message shows 'Failed to connect to server' instead of 'Invalid credentials' for wrong username/password - this is a minor UX issue

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Backend admin endpoints were not receiving Authorization header - added Header() import and updated all admin endpoints to use Header(None) for authorization parameter
Token storage is in-memory (admin_tokens dict) - tokens will be lost on server restart. Consider using Redis or database for production
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel is fully functional. Backend tests in /app/tests/test_admin_panel.py cover login, verify, dashboard stats, and all submission endpoints. The fix applied was adding Header() import to FastAPI and updating all admin endpoints to properly extract the Authorization header.

bug_fix_applied.issue: Admin API endpoints returning 401 Unauthorized even with valid token
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: FastAPI endpoints were using 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' which doesn't extract HTTP headers. Need to use 'authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)' to properly read the Authorization header.
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added 'Header' to FastAPI imports and updated all admin endpoints to use Header(None) for the authorization parameter
